power.name: Demonetisation
power.description: Every other team loses 10 points. A team that reaches 0 is banned for match fixing.

power.name: Adipurush VFX
power.description: The next auctioned player is visible only to you. Everyone else sees a glitched VFX loading card and bids blind.

power.name: What Do You Even Do?
power.description: Use a random other character's power, chosen only from powers that are valid right now. If that power needs a target, you pick it.

power.name: Chai Break
power.description: Unlimited pause. Only you can end it with Chai khatam. While it lasts you can read every team's squad and remaining points.

name: Big B

power.name: Lock Kiya Jaaye
power.description: A 50-50 coin flip on the current lot. Win the flip: if you win the player, you pay half. Lose the flip: whoever wins pays double.

lines: Rishte mein toh hum tumhare baap lagte hain

power.name: Broadcast Rights
power.description: On the next lot, each bid by a rival costs them 1 extra point, paid to you.

power.name: Chess Blundermaster
power.description: Privately see the next 3 players in auction order. A VFX-hidden player shows as ??? (VFX).

power.name: Elvish Bhai Ke Aage Koi Bol Sakta Hai Kya.. Elvish Bhaiiii
power.description: Mute the room: nobody can bid against you on this lot. You win at the current bid plus 1. Exempt from Broadcast Rights fees.

name: BeerBiceps

power.name: Parents Wala Sawaal
power.description: Pick a rival who cannot bid for this lot and the next one.

lines: Maut ke baare mein socha hai?

power.name: Kala Hiran
power.description: Pause and pick one of the last 10 sold rival players still on a squad, into a role you have open. You pay the sold price; the rival is refunded. 30 seconds; the power is used even if you time out.

name: Zindagi Jhand Ba

power.name: Ghamand Tax
power.description: Every team with more points than you pays you 5 points.

lines: Zindagi jhand ba, fir bhi ghamand ba

power.name: Rakhi Ka Swayamvar
power.description: Each rival may pay you 3 points or refuse. Refusers cannot bid on the next lot. On timeout they refuse.

name: Tay Tay

power.name: Travis Kelce Trade
power.description: Pause, pick one of the last 10 sold rival players still on a squad, then swap with one of your own same-role players. No points change. 30 seconds; the power is used even if you time out.

lines: Look what you made me do
We are never ever getting back together

power.name: Kahan Hai Points?
power.description: The richest other team (random tie-break) gives you 10 points.

name: Rocket Man

power.name: Big Red Button
power.description: Choose a team. Half of its squad (rounded down) is wiped at random and returns to the pool. That team is refunded a quarter of the points it has spent so far.

lines: Nuclear button is always on my desk
